critique.evidence: The cyan/red-on-black palette, oversized thesis statement, monospace evidence labels, and consistent card treatment create a distinctive, coherent security-lab aesthetic. Desktop has a strong left-versus-right narrative composition, but excessive unused lower space and faint connector lines weaken finish. Tablet becomes vertically sparse and visually disconnected, with the payment card floating far from the retrieved-page card. Mobile is readable but loses the intended flow entirely: cards become a plain stack, the headline wraps awkwardly, and the header visibly truncates “LIVE WI…”, making navigation feel unfinished. Tiny, low-contrast metadata and explanatory text also reduce polish across viewports; header contrast evidence remains incomplete at tablet and mobile.
critique.fix: Tighten tablet/desktop vertical rhythm, strengthen and realign the evidence connectors, and redesign mobile as an intentional compact timeline rather than a card stack. Prevent partial header labels by switching earlier to a clear menu/overflow treatment, improve muted-text contrast and size, and refine headline wrapping at 390px.
